name: Caresse, a Luxury Collection Resort
positioning: Caresse, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Bodrum: a beach resort on a private bay in Asarlik, between Bodrum and Bitez Bay, with Aegean views from every room
best_for: Travelers who want a private white sand beach and Aegean views
Spa-focused stays built around longevity treatments
Families or groups wanting a residence with a private pool

facts.text: The resort sits within a private bay in Bodrum.
The resort is in Asarlik, between Bodrum and Bitez Bay.
The Deluxe Marine Suite has a private terrace and garden with direct access to the beach.
The Caresse King Villa is two storeys.
The spa covers 1,600 square metres and offers a selection of local and international therapies.
All spa treatments include a journey through the Spa Caresse 'Degrees' heat experiences.
Guests can discover Caresse Art on an Art Tour.
Buddha-Bar Beach is a beachside restaurant and bar offering a day-to-night destination.
The Kids Art Studio offers children daily educational, creative and fun activities.
The resort facilitates sailing to the turquoise bays and islands of the Aegean Riviera.
Nearby historical sites include the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
The resort welcomes guests in every season, with its wellness and longevity facilities open year-round.

highlights.text: The private white sand beach has teak decks that create a natural saltwater pool.
An infinity pool perched above the shoreline looks out over the bay.
Every room has its own private terrace or balcony with a view of the Aegean Sea.
The Longevity Spa Bodrum offers signature rituals inspired by the world's Blue Zones, with treatments such as cryotherapy, LED therapy, natural body rituals and bespoke facials.
The three-bedroom Premiere Pool Residence has a private pool and sleeps up to ten guests.

considerations.text: Milas-Bodrum Airport is about 41 kilometres from the resort.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
